# Record 20261121-121745-8ab3406

- **Record ID**: 20261121-121745-8ab3406
- **Claim**: The T1 manifest still grades five items met and one not applicable after the NEC infrared receiver landed (issue #488): its `firmware-nec-ir-rx` experiment was registered in the item-9 testbench inventory (`manifests/evidence/testbenches.txt`, an item-10 attested file), so item 10 was re-attested for the new inventory hash.
- **Design provenance**: The manifest and evidence at `8ab340675` (the merge of `origin/main` into `feature/issue-488` for issue #488): the NEC infrared receiver's `firmware-nec-ir-rx` experiment registered in the item-9 testbench inventory (`manifests/evidence/testbenches.txt`, an item-10 attested file, so item 10 was re-attested for the merged inventory hash), plus everything the merge carried in from main — issue #523's item-11 two-part citation, the deck-bearing `librelane-erc` re-mint `20261121-002540-47e264ebc`, the `power-par-pdn` P&R power leg, and main's own supersession head `20261121-010127-b6c83b033`, which stays live beside this record (its single hashed input, the block manifest, is unchanged by this merge).
